messages:
sarah.m: Heads-up: nightly evals failing intermittently on GH Actions starting ~03:20 UTC. Looks like upload step errors with 500 sometimes and then multiple retries create clobbered artifacts.
omar.k: saw that too. failure is in `upload-artifact` step, error: `EEXIST` when two matrix shards try to upload same artifact name.
sasha: Confirmed. matrix config uses `artifact-name: eval-results` for all shards. Also discovered runner cache leak: `/tmp/eval-cache` persisted between jobs on same runner causing false-pass on quant tests.
sarah.m: that's bad. We need unique artifact names + better backoff. Proposed patch:

```
- name: Upload results
  uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
  with:
    name: eval-results
    path: results/${{ matrix.shard }}.json
```

-> change to

```
name: eval-results-${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ github.run_id }}
```

omar.k: also add exponential backoff wrapper around upload, and set `if: always()` to avoid skipping on partial failures.
sasha: For cache: runner cleanup is flaky. We should switch ephemeral runner labels for the matrix (use hosted runners or self-hosted ephemeral) or force `rm -rf /tmp/eval-cache` in a pre-step. Also add `--no-cache` flag to our eval runner when running in gha to avoid relying on runner-resident cache.

ci-bot: Suggestion: add a concurrency group to the workflow to prevent overlapping nightly runs: `concurrency: group: eval-nightly, cancel-in-progress: true`.
sarah.m: good call. Also schedule jitter is causing overlaps across regions; add `cron` randomized minute window and concurrency.

omar.k: I pushed a draft PR with artifact renaming + backoff wrapper: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/322
sasha: running an adhoc to verify. will post logs.
sasha: logs: upload succeeded after 2 retries, no EEXIST. runner-clean step removed /tmp/eval-cache.
sarah.m: awesome. we'll roll to nightly tomorrow. add monitoring alert for upload failures > 5% in 30m.

sasha: small follow-up: change `upload-artifact` to include `retention-days` so we can keep shards for debugging.
omar.k: noted. i'll update PR.
deploy-bot: nightly eval workflow scheduled: 2024-11-08T03:45:00Z
sarah.m: closing thread once PR merged. thanks y'all :tada:
